title: Ukrainian Shashlik Sausages
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring marinated sausages grilled to perfection. Serve with your favorite sides and condiments.

ingredients.name: Sausages
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of sausage you like, but traditional Ukrainian sausages are preferred.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onion for easy grilling.

ingredients.name: Bell Pepper
ingredients.notes: Any color bell pepper works well for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Sweet or smoked paprika, your preference.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor.

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the sausages, onion mixture, bell peppers, and tomatoes onto skewers.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the shashlik for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausages are cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot with your favorite sides and condiments.
